title: The tariff classification of a prefabricated sauna
summary: CBP determined that a freestanding, weather-resistant cross-laminated-timber sauna met the definition of a prefabricated building of wood.

title: Classification of an electric sauna heater in a DIY cedar sauna kit
summary: CBP Headquarters concluded that the electric sauna heater is classified as other electric space heating apparatus; other kit components are classified separately.

title: The tariff classification of a portable infrared sauna from China
summary: CBP classified a portable nylon-covered sauna with infrared panels and accessories as an other domestic electrothermic appliance.
